top_strength: Amy handled the live booking mechanics smoothly — she looped the daughter into the confirmation email in real time, had the customer verify receipt before hanging up, and calmly walked through the two-day drive/overnight-hotel logistics in a way that visibly answered the customer's scheduling anxiety.
coaching_note: When the customer volunteered new items (gym weights, TV console, bookcase, beds) not in the original estimate, Amy should have paused to re-verify the quote and run the Save Your Ass prep speech instead of just saying 'that's included' — as written, the customer booked a two-day, cross-state move without ever hearing the damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, or On-Time Guarantee differentiators.
phone_presence_notes: Amy is patient and reassuring ('no worries', 'totally fine', 'exactly') and ends warmly, but the call is largely transactional with heavy reliance on repeated 'yes ma'am' filler rather than genuine rapport-building or humor.
